data.body: Validated against origin/main 349d91bb27, which includes RP-01 commits 08bcb1f9..f0275172 and accepted ADR 0098. In the fresh origin/main worktree, 34 authoritative RP-01 bounded-operation, request-budget/retry-exhaustion, and candidate-tracing tests passed. Epic material now pins LLMRuntime injection to the existing PydanticAIRunner -> per-run ProviderSession -> one-Agent path and preserves RP-01 budget, complete-or-omit history, cache/accounting, exhaustion, artifact, tracing, usage, and failure behavior. The recovered RP-04 AST ownership guard is also explicit: a separate ownership-direction gate beside check_config_reads.py, local+CI wired, red-proofed across alias/environment access forms, exact justified exceptions only, zero legacy exceptions at cutover. Full validation note: .joe-janitor/rp04-origin-main-validation.md.
